```{r load libraries }
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)
library(car)

library(broom)
```

```{r Import task data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Disable scientific notation
options(scipen=999)

#pull data in terminal: aws s3 sync s3://neuroethics-task .
files <- list.files(path = here("data", "raw_mturk_data", "mturk_data_05202020"), pattern = "*.csv", full.names = T)
#load the raw data and select the relevant cols
raw.data <- map_dfr(files, readr::read_csv) %>% 
 dplyr::select(c("user_id", "rt", "key_press", "trial_index", "time_elapsed", 
"condition", "condition_per_trial", "total_trials", "treatment_display", 
"risk", "gain", "no_effect", "experimental_treatment_selected")) %>% 
  na.omit() -> raw.data

task_time <- raw.data %>% 
  dplyr::select(user_id,trial_index,time_elapsed) %>% 
  filter(trial_index == 229) %>% 
  mutate(time_elapsed = time_elapsed/60000)
```

```{r remove pilot data, eval=FALSE}
  filter(!str_detect(user_id, i))

for (i in Double.REMOVE$Completion_Code){
  clean.data <- clean.data %>% 
    filter(!str_detect(ResponseId, i))
}
```

```{r exclusion effort responce check}
#Remove subjects who failed attention checks attention checks
#Remove subjects who took below 5 mins
#Remove trials with RT outside the specifications; between 90000ms and 250ms 
clean.data %>% 
  filter(attention_check.1 == 1) %>% 
  filter(attention_check.2 == 1) %>% 
  filter(attention_check.3 == 1) %>% 
  filter(attention_check.4 == 1) %>% 
  mutate(time2completion  = Duration..in.seconds./60) %>% 
  filter(time2completion >= 5) %>% 
  filter(rt <= 90000 & rt >= 250) -> clean.data
#Remove Subjects who do not have at least 40 trials
clean.data <-  subset(clean.data, with(clean.data, user_id %in% names(which(table(user_id)>=40))))
```

```{r Lombrozo Moral Commitments task}
#need to fix how is scored
MC <- cbind(survey[1], survey[,133:138])
colnames(MC) = c( 'user_id', 'Lying','Assasination','Torture','Murder','Stealing','ForcedSterilization')

MC %>% 
  group_by(user_id) %>% 
  mutate(count = sum(Lying, Assasination, Torture, Murder,Stealing, ForcedSterilization))%>% 
  mutate(consequentialism.score = round(count/6, 3)) %>% 
  mutate(moral.commitment = if_else(consequentialism.score > .5,"Consequentialist", "Deontological"))-> MC

MC$moral.commitment <- as.factor(MC$moral.commitment)
MC$moral.commitment <- relevel(MC$moral.commitment, "Deontological")
```

```{r Subjective Numeracy Scale (SNS)}
SNS <- cbind(survey[,168:175], survey[1])

SNSList <- list(
  SNS.total <- SNS[,c(1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8)],
  SNS.ability <- SNS[,c(1,2,3,4)],
  SNS.preference <- SNS[,c(5,6,7,8)]
)

Results = list()
for (i in 1:3){
  totals <- apply(SNSList[[i]], 1, mean)
  Results[[i]] = totals 
}

TEST = do.call(rbind, Results)
colnames(TEST) = survey[,"user_id"]
rownames(TEST) <- c('SNS.total','SNS.ability','SNS.preference')
SNSsc <-  as.data.frame(t(TEST))
```

```{r Berlin Numeracy Test}
Berlin.Numeracy.Test<- cbind(survey[, 176:179], survey[1])
#Scoring = Based on answers to 1-4 questions following
#Correct answers are as follows: 
#1 = 25; 2 = 30; 3 =20; 4 = 50.
Berlin <- c("Berlin1","Berlin2","Berlin3","Berlin4")
Berlin.Numeracy.Test$Berlin1<- ifelse(Berlin.Numeracy.Test$Berlin1 == 25, 1,0)  
Berlin.Numeracy.Test$Berlin2<- ifelse(Berlin.Numeracy.Test$Berlin2 == 30, 1,0)  
Berlin.Numeracy.Test$Berlin3<- ifelse(Berlin.Numeracy.Test$Berlin3 == 20, 1,0)  
Berlin.Numeracy.Test$Berlin4<- ifelse(Berlin.Numeracy.Test$Berlin4 == 50, 1,0)  

Berlin.Numeracy.Test$BerlinScore <- apply(Berlin.Numeracy.Test[,Berlin], 1, function(X) sum(X))
```

```{r get betas for within subject models, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
source(here("ext", "get_betas.R"))
source(here("ext", "get_pvalues.R"))

clean.data %>% 
  dplyr::select(user_id,risk,gain,experimental_treatment_selected) %>% 
  group_by(user_id) %>% 
  mutate(risk.c = scale(risk, scale = F)) %>% #center the variables
  mutate(gain.c = scale(gain, scale = F)) %>% 
  mutate(treatment = ifelse(experimental_treatment_selected == "Yes to treatment", 1, 0)) -> logit.data 

subjectModels <- get_betas(logit.data, treatment ~ risk.c + gain.c)

colnames(subjectModels) <-  c("user_id", "risk", "gain", "experimental_treatment_selected", "risk.centered", "gain.centered", "treatment", "(Intercept)", "Risk_Beta", 
"Gain_Beta", "risk_vif", "gain_vif", "vif_exclusion", "null.deviance", 
"df.null", "logLik", "AIC", "BIC", "deviance", "df.residual", 
"nobs")

subjectModels %>% 
 dplyr::select("user_id","(Intercept)", "Risk_Beta", 
"Gain_Beta", "risk_vif", "gain_vif", "vif_exclusion", "null.deviance", 
"df.null", "logLik", "AIC", "BIC", "deviance", "df.residual", 
"nobs") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(R.cs = 1- exp ( -(null.deviance - deviance) / nobs),
         Nagelkerke_R2 = R.cs / ( 1 - ( exp (-(null.deviance / nobs))))) -> subjectModels.r2

subjectModels.r2 %>%   
  group_by(user_id) %>% 
  filter(!Nagelkerke_R2 == -Inf) %>% 
  filter(!Nagelkerke_R2 <= quantile(subjectModels.r2$Nagelkerke_R2, .05)) %>% 
  nest() -> subjectModels 
colnames(subjectModels) = c("user_id", "logit_models")


Neuroethics_Judgement <-  merge(clean.data, subjectModels, "user_id")
```

```{r marginal effects, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
#calculate average marginal effects
source(here("ext", "get_marginal.R"))

marginal = get_marginal(logit.data, treatment ~ risk.c + gain.c)
marginal %>% 
  dplyr::select(c("user_id","risk_average_marginal_effect", 
"risk_Std_Err", "risk_z", "risk_P>|z|", "gain_average_marginal_effect", 
"gain_Std_Err", "gain_z", "gain_P>|z|")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(user_id) %>% 
  nest() -> marginal
colnames(marginal) = c("user_id", "marginal")

Neuroethics_Judgement <-  merge(Neuroethics_Judgement, marginal, "user_id")
```
